title: Scalar-Tensor Hydrodynamics: Gravity as the Response of a Vacuum Medium. A Modified Gravity Framework for Vacuum Viscosity and Cyclic Vacuum Cosmology
description:
A theoretical proposal built on one premise: there is no empty space. The vacuum is treated as a single continuous medium, the Ocean, with its own stress-energy, pressure, internal flow and dissipative response, and with no edges and no outside. What are conventionally called particles are treated as localized excitations of the medium, and gravity is proposed to be the medium's response to concentrated energy. The medium has one speed, at which every disturbance travels, and gravity is where that speed varies from place to place. No speed is fixed: the measured speed of light is the local carrying speed read by rulers and clocks made of the same medium. Einstein's equation is retained as the effective description of that response.

The formalism adds to the Einstein tensor a dynamical scalar-field sector, a vacuum viscous stress, a field-dependent pressure in place of a fixed cosmological constant, and a state-dependent effective coupling. Version 3.10 removes the fixed speed of light that the standard way of writing the medium's law had built into every term, and writes the law on the medium's own rulers and clocks. The carrying speed then has two readings, the same on the spot and varying from afar, and a stiff medium removes the mismatch between the speed limits of light and matter. Two principles of the framework, that the medium stays in step and that nothing is counted twice, give General Relativity's geometry outside a non-spinning mass, including its point of no return and the observed size of the shadow of Sagittarius A*. Nothing happens at the point of no return; what falls in flows through, and a loosening of the medium's grip is offered as the one candidate mechanism that turns around both a black hole's core and a beat's contraction. A column-like swirl in a galaxy is shown to turn a star's travel only inward, never vertically, the property local Milky Way data require.

Version 3.11 gives frame dragging to first order in spin from inside the medium, with the Earth itself treated as the medium: a pattern's slowed surroundings are re-made as it travels and tilted by its travel, and summed over the Earth's spinning parts they give the turning measured by Gravity Probe B, LAGEOS, LARES and LARES-2, while travel through the medium itself leaves no trace. The turning is carried by quantized lines, whose circulation is set by the medium's phase rate; read over at least one line spacing they turn a gyroscope exactly as smooth turning does. This requires a phase rate today far larger than the minimal law allows, and the law that allows it is set out as required. The same work shows that matter and antimatter must carry the same charge of the medium's U(1). Every part of the paper now carries a checksum token, and a reading manifest with a document digest (9031-3435-17da) lets any reader confirm a complete reading.

The medium is written as a complex field whose amount sets the electron scale and whose phase rate sets the pressure and the rest frame. Its excitations divide into two branches on one cone: the gapped amount mode, whose quanta are localized and make up matter, and the gapless phase ripple, which is coherent. The healing length is the inverse cost of a dent in the medium and recovers the electron rest energy as a calibration rather than an input; the electron's mass, and the strength of gravity with it, are constants of the present beat. A cyclic Heartbeat cosmology, with beats driven by events rather than set by a clock, is treated separately within the present beat and across beats. The galactic sector, the conservation of the medium's state, and the vacuum and matter-antimatter effects already measured are addressed.

This is a proposal, not an established theory. The document states its own falsification conditions explicitly and carries an itemized research program, several items of which could terminate the framework.
